# Aizaz Sheikh

> Aizaz Sheikh helps travel brands get seen, and get chosen, in a world where discovery is always changing. He is a Toronto-based travel marketing strategist, keynote speaker and advisor, a Fellow of the Chartered Institute of Marketing (FCIM) and a board member of Tourism Cares.

## Expertise
- Marketing for experience-led travel brands: tour operators, destinations and travel advisors
- Relevance over reach: interest media, storytelling, creators, amplification and culture
- Trust and brand: why travellers choose one brand over another, and how AI assistants decide which brands to recommend
- Social First marketing: social as an input into strategy, not the final step in distribution
- AI discovery and practical AI workflows for travel marketing teams

## Background
- More than fifteen years in marketing, most of it in travel, including brand, content and community leadership at G Adventures, Travelzoo and TourRadar
- Keynote speaker at the Adventure Travel World Summit: "From Reach to Relevance" (Chile, 2025) and "Close the Distance" (Québec City, 2026)

## Keynotes
- From Reach to Relevance: Interest creates reach. Story creates value.
- Close the Distance: Trust is the transaction layer.
- Seen Isn't Chosen: Attention is the entry fee. Trust is the transaction.

## Advisory
- Distance Audit, leadership alignment, 8-week pilot, then scale
